sender.ms: “Peguam”, “pegawai kes penipuan” atau “ejen pemulihan dana” yang menghubungi anda selepas anda ditipu
sender.en: A “lawyer”, “fraud case officer” or “fund recovery agent” who contacts you after you were scammed

name.ms: Penipuan “pemulihan wang”: janji dapatkan semula wang yang sudah ditipu
name.en: “Money recovery” scam: a promise to get back money you already lost

how.ms: Selepas anda ditipu dalam skim pelaburan atau pembelian dalam talian, seseorang menghubungi anda melalui media sosial atau telefon dan mengaku peguam, pegawai yang mengendalikan kes penipuan dalam talian, atau ejen pemulihan dana. Dia menawarkan untuk mendapatkan semula wang anda, tetapi anda perlu membayar “yuran guaman”, “caj pemprosesan” atau bayaran dalam mata wang kripto dahulu. Setiap bayaran diikuti permintaan baharu, sehingga dia menyekat nombor anda.
how.en: After you have been scammed in an investment scheme or an online purchase, someone contacts you on social media or by phone claiming to be a lawyer, an officer handling online fraud cases, or a fund recovery agent. They offer to get your money back, but you must first pay “legal fees”, a “processing charge” or a payment in cryptocurrency. Every payment is followed by a new demand, until they block your number.

text.ms: Selepas ditipu, anda dihubungi oleh “peguam” atau “pegawai” yang tahu tentang kerugian anda.
text.en: After being scammed, you are contacted by a “lawyer” or “officer” who knows about your loss.

text.ms: Dia berjanji mendapatkan semula semua wang anda dengan cepat.
text.en: They promise to get all your money back quickly.

text.ms: Anda perlu membayar yuran, caj atau kripto dahulu, berkali-kali.
text.en: You must pay fees, charges or crypto first, again and again.

text.ms: Salam puan, saya pegawai dari unit pemulihan dana penipuan dalam talian. Kami dapati wang puan RM85,000 masih boleh dituntut semula. Untuk membuka fail tuntutan, puan perlu bayar yuran guaman RM3,500 dahulu. Proses ini sulit, jangan kongsi dengan sesiapa.
text.en: Hello madam, I am an officer from the online scam fund recovery unit. We found that your RM85,000 can still be claimed back. To open the claim file, you need to pay RM3,500 in legal fees first. This process is confidential, don't share it with anyone.

ms: peguam tawar dapatkan semula duit yang kena tipu
kena bayar yuran untuk pulihkan wang pelaburan
pegawai kes penipuan minta bayaran dalam kripto
ditipu kali kedua oleh ejen pemulihan dana
janji duit kena scam boleh dapat balik kalau bayar caj
en: a lawyer offered to get back the money i was scammed out of
had to pay a fee to recover my investment money
fraud case officer asked for payment in crypto
scammed a second time by a fund recovery agent
promised my scammed money back if i paid a charge

ms: Orang yang menghubungi anda dahulu dan tahu anda baru ditipu.
Perlu membayar untuk mendapatkan semula wang anda sendiri.
Bayaran dalam mata wang kripto atau ke akaun individu.
en: Someone who contacts you first and knows you were just scammed.
Having to pay to get your own money back.
Payment in cryptocurrency or to a personal account.

ms: Jangan bayar sesiapa untuk “memulihkan” wang anda. Polis, NSRC dan bank tidak mengenakan bayaran.
Laporkan kerugian asal hanya kepada 997, bank anda dan balai polis.
Sekat orang itu dan simpan tangkapan layar perbualan.
en: Don't pay anyone to “recover” your money. The police, NSRC and banks don't charge for this.
Report the original loss only to 997, your bank and the police station.
Block the person and keep screenshots of the conversation.

sources.title: Woman at a loss after fake Hong Kong lawyer offers to recover money from previous scam
Saleswoman loses RM290,910 to investment scam before falling prey to fake recovery agent

story.ms: Seorang wanita berusia 27 tahun di Miri, yang sebelum itu ditipu dalam pembelian barang kemas di media sosial, dihubungi oleh seseorang yang mengaku peguam dari Hong Kong dan menawarkan untuk mendapatkan semula wangnya. Dia diarah membayar dalam mata wang kripto melalui 12 transaksi dalam tempoh kira-kira sebulan dan kehilangan RM622,792.65, sebelum nombornya disekat.
story.en: A 27-year-old woman in Miri, who had earlier been cheated in a jewellery purchase on social media, was contacted by someone claiming to be a Hong Kong lawyer who offered to recover her money. She was told to pay in cryptocurrency in 12 transactions over about a month and lost RM622,792.65 before her number was blocked.
